user.description: A user manages only their own lists and tasks.

browser.description: Calls the JSON API over HTTPS.

api.description: Validates bearer identity and exposes task CRUD endpoints.

storage.description: Persists lists and tasks in a transaction.

controller.description: HTTP boundary: GET /lists/{id}/todos; POST; PATCH /todos/{id}; DELETE /todos/{id}.

service.description: Checks ownership and coordinates CRUD transactions.

repository.description: Persistence contract used by application service.

sql-repository.description: Implements the repository using parameterized SQL.

list.description: Named collection belonging to an account.

todo.description: A task can be open, completed, reopened or archived.

request.description: Request DTO with title and listId.

response.description: Response DTO with identity, title and completion status.

uc-create.description: POST validates title, checks list ownership and returns 201 with the persisted Todo.

uc-read.description: GET returns only tasks in a list owned by the caller.

uc-update.description: PATCH updates title or completed with optimistic version checking.

uc-delete.description: DELETE archives the task and returns 204; unknown or foreign IDs return 404.

lifecycle-recovery.description: Independent compensation behavior; never a submachine of Archived.
